_rule: A MODELLED company, not a client. Every number in this file is an assumption, labelled as one, and every one can be changed on the page. Measured figures come from evidence/fallfloor.json; prices from sources/prices.json.
name: A modelled UK digital bank with EU customers

profile.footprint: Head office in the UK; customers in the UK and the EU — so UK GDPR, EU GDPR (Art 3(2)) and, where AI output is used in the EU, the EU AI Act (Art 2(1)(c)) all apply.

growth.why: Volume growth per year for the automated workloads; seats are held flat.

nodeShare.why: A quarter of laptops enrolled as AI nodes — on mains power, managed by device policy.

hoursPerDay.why: Node hours per working day while the laptop is on and plugged in.

model.name: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (Apache 2.0), 4-bit
model.why: 32.8B parameters (Hugging Face model card) at 4-bit plus overhead ≈ 18 GB.

efficiency.why: Share of the memory-bandwidth ceiling reached when generating (decode is bandwidth-bound: tokens/s ≤ bandwidth ÷ weight size). The laptop in the fallfloor run reached less; Phase 1 measures the real figure on the chosen node before more are bought.

prefillTokPerSec.why: Planning figure for reading the prompt on the core node; Phase 1 measures it.

hoursPerMonth.why: Core nodes serve office hours plus overnight batch work (about 16 h a day).

targetUtil.why: Headroom for peaks; queued work absorbs the rest.

lifeYears.why: Replace core nodes every four years.

workloads.name: Customer support: route, topic and a first draft for the agent
workloads.why: Measured in fallfloor: route → topic → draft on the laptop floor.

workloads.name: Inbound message screening: flag suspected spam and scams for review
Staff HR helpdesk: route each question to the right HR topic
workloads.why: Measured in fallfloor (CLINC150 work topics). Routing a question is a narrow procedural task, not an employment decision (AI Act Art 6(3)(a)).

workloads.name: Customer replies at production quality, drafted on the core tier for agent approval
workloads.why: Tokens: the measured fallfloor support prompt (831 in / 73 out) plus the retrieved help-article text and a longer reply — an estimate.

workloads.name: Internal knowledge assistant for staff (answers from the bank's own documents)
workloads.why: 1,000 knowledge workers × 10 questions a working day × 21 days. On the corporate side this is what the seats buy. Tokens are an estimate (retrieved passages in, a short answer out).

workloads.name: KYC document field extraction, checked by an analyst
workloads.why: Reading identity and address documents into structured fields. Not biometric identification; an analyst confirms every record. Tokens are an estimate.

outOfScope.name: Credit decisions
outOfScope.why: High-risk under AI Act Annex III 5(b) from 2 December 2027, a fundamental rights impact assessment (Art 27) and GDPR Art 22 / UK Arts 22A–22D. Not in this rollout; the gate shows why.

onCost.why: Employer's National Insurance, pension and overheads on top of salary — an estimate; change it.

local.role: Infrastructure / SRE for the core nodes and the floor
Data protection and AI governance (with the DPO)

cloud.role: Data protection and AI governance (with the DPO)

staff.why: Team sizes are this design's assumptions. Salaries are ONS medians (sources/prices.json).

dayRate.why: Blended cost of a day of legal / privacy specialist time — an assumption; change it.

local.why: DPIAs per workload, AI system register, AI literacy plan, Article 50 notices, supply-chain and device security reviews.

cloud.why: The same, plus processor due diligence and contracts for each AI vendor, transfer risk assessments, and yearly vendor reviews.

policy._what: The go/no-go thresholds this design proposes to the CTO. They are choices, not facts, and the page lets you change them.
